 Santiago & Romero Law Group

Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1404
Our client: Joshua Lee
Date of loss: 05/17/2023
Dear Claims Representative:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. Please
direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our clinet directly, either by telephone, in
writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let
us know so that we may address it.
We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every poilcy that may apply to this loss,
including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim and written confirmation of
coverage positions as they are determined.
We also ask that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and
telematics, dash camera footage, photographs, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any communications with
third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Eric Phillips
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
